summary: CVLN Agent Factory V1 — full-stack testing PASSED. 34/34 backend pytest cases green (auth, registry read/compile, ADL validate, generator pipeline, doctrine, external 501, events/memory/audit/monitoring, users management, authz denials). Frontend UI verified end-to-end: login → dashboard → agents (search + filter + AGT-000 detail with 4 tabs) → ADL editor (live validation) → Generator (11-step pipeline produced AGT-803 in Beta with svc_ token displayed) → doctrine (6 sections, 8 external systems) → events → audit → monitoring (5 healthy services) → users (created via UI) → FR/EN toggle. The previously reported 'destroy is not a function' regression on Generator/Users/AgentDetail is FIXED — no page crash, useEffect(load) no longer returns a promise.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_utils.get_current_actor sets no rate limit / lockout on failed login — spec/playbook expects 5-attempt lockout; not implemented (not in scope of V1 request but flag).

backend/.env sets CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True — starlette silently disables credentialed CORS on '*'. Cookies work same-site here but any browser using a different origin will not receive access_token cookie. Consider explicit origin list.
seed_data.py imports create indexes AFTER inserts every startup — acceptable but noisy on cold start; safe.

generator_routes.build_adl_from_definition passes brain.identity.autonomy_level via kwargs — pydantic will accept but ADLDocument does not validate autonomy_level enum; DOC-AUT-01 catches at doctrine layer only.
ADL editor spec requires ability to compile via UI — flow works (compile button appears once validation is green). Confirmed manually with existing template.
core_routes.log_memory_access called on read even for foreign agents' memory only after successful read; denied reads log via log_authz — OK.
No pagination on /api/registry/agents (limit 2000) — acceptable for target of 284 agents.
